description: [WRITE] Create a Microsoft Ads (Bing) UET Conversions API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/microsoft-capi-tag), imported automatically. uetTagId is the UET Tag ID (public; the built-in web tag stores it as tagId), authToken the API token. `event` is the conversion goal / GA4 name. REQUIRES the MSCLKID to be forwarded from the web side for attribution. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

authToken.description: Microsoft Ads CAPI API token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

eventData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Microsoft Ads CAPI Tag".

serverData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_microsoft_capi_server_tag
